vulnerability.name: USN-8949-1
vulnerability.description: Rick de Jager discovered that Ghostscript incorrectly handled memory under certain circumstances when processing PostScript documents. If a user or automated system were tricked into processing a specially crafted document, an attacker could possibly use this issue to bypass the sandbox and execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2026-101258)  It was discovered that Ghostscript incorrectly handled memory when converting certain fonts. If a user or automated system were tricked into processing a specially crafted file, an attacker could possibly use this issue to cause Ghostscript to crash, or possibly execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2026-103226)  Paulos Yibelo discovered that Ghostscript did not properly validate certain operands when loading fonts. If a user or automated system were tricked into processing a specially crafted file, an attacker could possibly use this issue to bypass the sandbox and execute arbitrary code. (No CVE number)

statements.status_notes: Several security issues were fixed in Ghostscript.
